description: This file defines the SingleNoteWidgetData class, which is an entity representing widget data for a single note within an Android application. It extends AbstractWidgetData, includes database mapping annotations, manages note identifier data, and overrides equality and hash code methods.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidgetData
classes.description: An entity class representing widget data for a single note, designed to be stored in a Room database with foreign key relationships to Account and Note entities.

methods.name: SingleNoteWidgetData
methods.description: Constructor with parameters to initialize the entity with specific id, accountId, noteId, and modeId.

methods.name: getNoteId
methods.description: Returns the note ID associated with this widget data.

methods.name: setNoteId
methods.description: Sets the note ID for this widget data.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on noteId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on noteId.
